def move_one_ball(arr):
    if not arr:
        return True
    
    if arr == sorted(arr):
        return True
    
    min_index = arr.index(min(arr))
    shifts_needed = len(arr) - min_index - 1
    
    return shifts_needed % len(arr) == 0
